description: Numerical evaluation of the BW shadow-price coefficient C_{[3,2,1]} at q_0 via the closed form from prop:wigner-2-coefficient.  Uses [n]_q · h / [3]_q^3 · [5]_q closed form; cross-checks via Wigner-2 corollary C = w · h/2.
scope_note: C_{[3,2,1]} is the SINGLE-PARTITION shadow price at k=6 (A=2 only).  The empirical α_5 fit from the higher-A shell diagnostic aggregates over ALL height-6 partitions across A=1..4.  Direct numerical comparison requires per-partition decomposition (see paper_six_term_isotope_sweep refactor).
